title: 1,500-year-old child burial unearthed in Peru with whistles, rattle and vessel
summary_full: Archaeologists found a 1,500-year-old infant burial in northern Peru.  The child was buried with whistles, a rattle, and a sculptural vessel.  This burial displays patterns characteristic of the ancient Moche culture.  The discovery occurred in a residential area, offering insights into daily life.  Excavations continue to expand understanding of the Moche community.
